name: SDI Felt-Win Demo Design + Endgame Gap Analysis
head: a45769d52

current_sdi_layer.name: Context-residency SDI v0.1.1
current_sdi_layer.definition: A context-selection and memory-guard prototype operating above the KV layer, deciding what to present to the model rather than changing how the model processes it
helps_with: Long/noisy context compression via structured packet summaries
Pinned fact preservation across extended conversations
Exact tool output formatting (paths, hashes, IDs)
Preventing swap-risky runs through pre-run memory guards
does_not_solve: Dense per-token weight streaming from DRAM
KV cache allocation or eviction policies inside the backend
Layer skipping or FFN activation reduction

demo_scenario.name: Engineering Handoff Recovery
demo_scenario.setup: A long noisy engineering conversation containing: old/wrong plan, corrected current state with tracking ID, hard constraint, exact path/commit/hash, open loop, ~2000+ chars debug log filler
demo_scenario.user_question: Where are we, what is the current truth, and what should I do next?
demo_scenario.expected_baseline_failures: no_packet confused by old/wrong plan; recent_only loses pinned constraint; simple_summary loses exact paths/open loops
demo_scenario.expected_sdi_auto_behavior: Structured packet preserves current truth, exact ID, open loop, and next action clearly

demo_success_criteria.sdi_auto_wins: SDI auto produces a clearly better answer than at least 2 baselines
demo_success_criteria.baseline_fails_meaningfully: At least one baseline fails to retrieve the tracking ID or open loop

demo_failure_criteria.all_tie: All four policies return equivalent answers
demo_failure_criteria.simple_summary_matches: simple_summary or recent_only matches SDI auto quality
demo_failure_criteria.not_confusing_enough: Old wrong plan is not actually confusing to baselines
demo_failure_criteria.too_synthetic: Demo requires hype to feel convincing

demo_artifact.status: DESIGN ONLY — do not implement without Phase 28E approval
demo_artifact.behavior: Run one scenario through all 4 policies; print side-by-side readable outputs; show winner + token reduction + swap before/after; write outputs to /tmp only

endgame_gap_analysis.core_gap: Context-residency SDI is ~15% of the problem. Remaining 85% is weight residency + compute density.

layers.remains: PRT v3 or native backend needed

next_mechanism_candidates.name: KV/cache policy design
next_mechanism_candidates.risk: Requires backend internals or API support

recommended_next_phase: Phase 28E: implement the felt-win demo first — makes current layer tangible and validates whether context selection is the bottleneck or weight residency is
